title: Private Edge Gatekeeper: launch comms, release notes, and cross-team GTM for RBAC/Audit/KMS
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver coordinated launch artifacts and cross-functional execution for the Private Edge Gatekeeper feature set (RBAC roles, signed audit logs, customer KMS integration). This ticket centralizes release notes, customer-facing comms, internal enablement, and a phased GTM schedule to ensure compliance customers can adopt with minimal friction.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted and reviewed by legal, security, and docs
Customer enablement kit (one-pager + setup checklist) published to Drive
Console banners and in-product upgrade flow copy finalized and QAed
Support playbook with triage steps and escalation path added to internal wiki
Rollout wave schedule confirmed and communicated to sales/CS/SEs
tasks: Draft consolidated release notes covering RBAC, audit logs, and KMS integration
Coordinate legal/security sign-off on audited wording and retention disclosures
Prepare in-console copy and feature flag gating checklist with Design
Create customer-facing KB: setup steps, common errors, troubleshooting tips
Organize two enablement sessions for Sales and Solutions Engineers
Publish a short video walkthrough for the admin flow and key audit views
Confirm metrics/dashboarding requirements with Observability team
rollout_plan: Wave 0 (internal): feature flag enabled for Redwood internal orgs only - 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-05
Wave 1 (trusted partners): invite-only pilot with three enterprise customers - 2026-03-08 to 2026-03-22
Wave 2 (opt-in GA): customers can opt into Gatekeeper via Console - 2026-03-29
Wave 3 (enforced GA): default available for dedicated/private deployments, announcements + documentation updates - 2026-04-12
release_notes_outline: Headline: Private Edge Gatekeeper - RBAC, Signed Audit Logs, and Customer KMS
Whats new: short bullets for each capability and intended benefit

Known limitations: list of edge cases and timelines for fixes
Changelog: link to engineering PRs and runtime release notes

risks_mitigations: Risk: KMS integration edge cases cause onboarding delays - Mitigation: provide step-by-step troubleshooting KB and quick rollback to default key
Risk: Audit log signing format changes impact customer ingestions - Mitigation: publish schema and provide transformation examples; include compatibility window
Risk: RBAC roles leak permissions in complex org trees - Mitigation: ship conservative default role sets and include a role simulator in the UI
Risk: Support volume spike post-GA - Mitigation: prepare canned responses, temporary triage rotations, and priority escalation path
